title: Music at the Onion Stall
paras: Mina sold vegetables at a small city market. Her brother Ravi helped, but they often spoke angrily during busy hours. A [[professor|professor]] who lived nearby asked to try an experiment. Could quiet music [[improve|improve]] the [[relationship|relationship]] between them at work? Mina agreed to test the idea for six mornings. They chose the same hours each day, from eight until eleven.

For three mornings, they worked without music. For the next three, they listened to soft [[jazz|jazz]]. Each wore a headset with only the left [[headphone|headphone]] over one ear, so they could still hear customers. Mina put some soft [[cotton|cotton]] under the headband because it hurt her head. The researcher sat nearby and counted angry words. She also counted helpful actions, such as carrying a heavy bag together. During every test, one [[kilogramme|kilogramme]] of potatoes [[plus|plus]] one large [[onion|onion]] cost two coins.

On the music days, the pair used fewer angry words and helped each other more. However, a [[storm|storm]] kept many customers away on two of those mornings. Perhaps less work, not music, made them kinder. The researcher planned another test. Mina smiled: the music had not proved anything yet, but she and Ravi now noticed when they were kind.
zh: 米娜在城里一个小市场卖蔬菜。她的兄弟拉维帮她干活，但忙碌时，两人说话常常带着火气。一位住在附近的教授提出做个实验。轻柔的音乐能改善他们工作时的关系吗？米娜同意用六个上午来试一试。他们每天都选在同一个时段，从八点到十一点。
前三个上午，他们工作时不听音乐。接下来的三个上午，他们听轻柔的爵士乐。两人都戴着头戴式耳机，但只把左边的听筒放在一只耳朵上，这样仍能听见顾客说话。米娜在耳机头带下面垫了一些柔软的棉花，因为头带压得她头疼。研究人员坐在附近，记录他们说气话的次数。她也记录互相帮忙的行为，比如一起搬一个沉重的袋子。每次测试期间，一公斤土豆加一个大洋葱都卖两枚硬币。
听音乐的日子里，两人说的气话更少，互相帮忙的次数也更多。不过，其中两个上午，一场暴风雨让许多顾客没有来市场。也许让他们更友善的是工作少了，而不是音乐。研究人员计划再做一次测试。米娜笑了：音乐的效果还没有得到证明，但她和拉维现在会留意彼此友善的举动了。

q.s: Mina agreed to test the idea for six weeks.
q.why: 她同意试六个上午，而不是六周。

q.s: Ravi chose the jazz music for the test.
q.why: 文中未说明爵士乐由谁挑选。

q.s: There were fewer angry words on the music days.
q.why: 文中明确说听音乐时气话更少。
